parole.significato: The Neutral Nation, a tribal confederation of Iroquoian peoples.
parole.testo: Likely from a Iroquoian term; perhaps Wendat attiwentaronk ("they are partially comprehensible").

parole.significato: Any of three long-legged and long-billed migratory wading birds in the genus Limnodromus of the family Scolopacidae.
parole.testo: From an Iroquoian language; compare Oneida tawístawe (“snipe”).

parole.significato: The greatest title of authority and honor bestown by the Commonwealth of Kentucky, recognizing noteworthy accomplishmen…
parole.testo: Origin unconfirmed from 1775. As a compound word that was merged from two lexemes the title is a demonym and exonym label that emerged in the early 19th century to refer to the old colonial leaders of Kentucky. parole.significato: A flood, torrent, or outpouring, especially one of massive proportions.
parole.testo: From an Iroquoian language; compare Mohawk ohnyá:kara' (“neck of land”). The name of the tribe which resided in the area was recorded on early maps as Onguiarahronon or Niagagarega.

parole.significato: An American aromatic herb (Monarda didyma) with bright red labiate flowers; also called bee balm or bergamot.
